chunks: A votary when he turns to his devotions?

key_terms.صَلَّىٰ: He prayed or turned to devotions, referring to ritual worship or salat
key_terms.عَبْداً: A servant or worshipper, referring to one who submits to God

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of a servant's prayer in Shia Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of 'abd (servitude) as the foundation of 'ibadah (worship), where the believer's physical prostration reflects an inner state of total submission to the Divine Will. It connects the ritual act of salat with the broader theological theme of recognizing one's created status before the Creator, a key element in understanding the verses of Surah Al-Alaq regarding the descent of revelation.
